Full job description

We are looking for a Cloud Support Engineer with 3 to 6 years of experience to join our platform team in Pune. You will build and operate the services behind our customer-facing products.

Responsibilities

  • Design and ship REST APIs in Python and Django.
  • Own the PostgreSQL schema and its migrations.
  • Keep the service running on AWS, with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Write the tests that let the team deploy twice a day.

Required skills

Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Git, Linux, REST API

Experience

2 - 5 years

Job Type

Full-time, Permanent
